messages.content: I'll give that a try. I've got some compost in the shed, so I'll spread a bit around the base of the plants tomorrow. I'm hoping it helps them hold on until the rain comes.
That sounds like a perfect plan! Hopefully, that extra organic matter will help them through the dry spells. Keep us posted on how it goes!

I'll definitely let you know how it works out. I've got a few other small things I'm trying too, like shading the most vulnerable ones with a cloth during the hottest part of the day. It's all just little steps, but I guess that's what matters.

Sounds like a good strategy! Shading those vulnerable plants is smart, especially during the heat. It sounds like you're being very careful with your garden! Let me know how those extra plants do after you've tried the compost!
How about we check the soil moisture in a few of the pots tomorrow? I'm curious if the compost is making a difference in how quickly they dry out.
